TC → FI from the §5 evaluation table (edge colour = evaluation outcome of that row); FI → SH from the Linked SH column of §3. Texts are shortened; the tables are the source.
“Needs modification”: a functional modification in WP-C-07 or an ODD restriction is required; “Needs validation”: acceptability depends on evidence from WP-V-03 (§1).

Acceptable rows carry a condition (§5): TC-19 for large errors; small errors need validation; TC-21 after FM-03 (stale-input handling); TC-28 with user info (driver-initiated, abortable); needs validation of abort controllability.
